core_obligations: Identify the two categories (proof lines 6574-6592): the pullback of the structure sheaf is the structure sheaf, so the pullback on modules agrees with the inverse image; every object of the given subcategory is a sheaf for both topologies, so it embeds fully faithfully into the modules on the finer site, and the pushforward and pullback are quasi-inverse equivalences onto the image.

Vanishing of the higher direct images (proof lines 6594-6600): assumptions (3) and (4) together with the description of the higher direct images as sheafifications of the local cohomology presheaf give the vanishing in positive degrees on the subcategory.

The image is a weak Serre subcategory (proof lines 6600-6652): for an exact sequence of objects of the image, the author displays the comparison diagram with the unit of the adjunction, notes that the lower row is exact and that the outer vertical arrows are isomorphisms, and applies the five lemma to place the middle term in the image.

Apply the comparison criterion (proof lines 6654-6666): the derived categories of the weak Serre subcategories may be formed, and conditions (1) to (5) of the companion criterion are verified, giving the asserted equivalence.
proof_roadmap: Show that the given subcategory sits equivalently inside the modules on the finer site.
Deduce the vanishing of the positive higher direct images from the two conditions on coverings and cohomology.
Prove that the image is a weak Serre subcategory by a five lemma, and verify the conditions of the comparison criterion.
difficulty_reason: The lemma compares two topologies at the level of derived categories: under the covering and vanishing conditions for a family of objects, the given subcategory is a weak Serre subcategory of the modules on the finer site and the pullback and derived pushforward give an equivalence of triangulated categories (statement lines 6550-6570). The proof is a complete argument: the identification of the subcategory with its image and the quasi-inverse equivalences are established (proof lines 6574-6592); the vanishing of the positive higher direct images is deduced from the two assumptions through the description of those sheaves (proof lines 6594-6600); the image is shown to be a weak Serre subcategory by a comparison diagram and the five lemma (proof lines 6600-6652); and the five conditions of the comparison criterion are checked, yielding the equivalence (proof lines 6654-6666). The non-formal content is the verification of the weak Serre property and of the criterion. The claim is H2: a structured argument with each input named.
